page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The optical reason
lines: Diamond has a very high refractive
Light entering a cut diamond is
reflected many times inside the stone
and white light entering it is split
steps.why: The gem value comes from an optical property, not from the bonding. A high refractive index bends light sharply on entry and keeps it inside the stone through repeated reflections, so a cut diamond returns far more light to the eye than an ordinary transparent stone.
common_mistakes: Giving hardness as the only reason. The brightness of a diamond comes from its high refractive index.
Writing that a diamond gives out light of its own. It only refracts and reflects the light that falls on it.
steps.memory_tip: A high refractive index keeps light inside the stone, so it shines.
steps.margin_note: Name the refractive index first; it is the main reason.

steps.label: Hardness and unreactivity
lines: Diamond is the hardest known substance,
so a cut and polished face is not
scratched in ordinary use and the stone
keeps its shape and its polish.
It is also chemically unreactive at
ordinary temperature, so it does not

lines.text: Bright, hard and unchanging: a valued gem

steps.why: Brightness alone would not make a gem. The cut faces that produce the brightness must not be worn away, so the hardness and the chemical unreactivity are what keep the stone looking the same for years.
common_mistakes: Writing that a diamond can be scratched by steel. Diamond is the hardest known substance, so steel cannot scratch it.
Saying diamond is valued because it conducts electricity. Diamond is a bad conductor of electricity.
steps.memory_tip: Hard and unreactive means the cut faces and the polish last.
steps.margin_note: Add hardness and unreactivity after the optical reason to complete the answer.

insider_note: A complete answer names the high refractive index as the reason for the brightness and then adds that diamond is the hardest known substance and does not tarnish, so the polish lasts.
